title: The Key
description: A tugboat captain (William Holden) inherits an apartment and a woman (Sophia Loren) from another tugboat captain (Trevor Howard) in World War II England.

title: The Chase
description: An escaped convict (Robert Redford) heads for his wife (Jane Fonda) and corrupt small-town Texans, who order a sheriff (Marlon Brando) to stop him.

title: A Raisin in the Sun
description: Proud members (Sidney Poitier, Claudia McNeil, Ruby Dee) of a Chicago family argue over a $10,000 insurance windfall.

title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
description: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.

title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
description: A country bumpkin faces ridicule and corruption when he takes his idealistic views to the nation's capital.

title: A Night to Remember
description: A mystery writer and his wife find a corpse in the backyard of their Greenwich Village apartment.

title: Shockproof
description: An ex-convict (Patricia Knight) flees with her Los Angeles parole officer (Cornel Wilde) after shooting her former lover (John Baragrey).

title: Love Has Many Faces
description: A woman (Lana Turner) lives in Acapulco with moochers and a husband (Cliff Robertson) who married her for her money.

title: It Had to Be You
description: A marriage-shy sculptor (Ginger Rogers) meets the Indian boy of her childhood dreams, now a firefighter (Cornel Wilde).

title: The Jolson Story
description: At the turn of the 20th century, young Asa Yoelson decides to go against the wishes of his cantor father and pursue a career in show business.

title: Theodora Goes Wild
description: A small-town New England author (Irene Dunne) meets her racy novel's urbane illustrator (Melvyn Douglas) in Manhattan.

title: Miss Sadie Thompson
description: A shady woman (Rita Hayworth) from San Francisco joins Marines and a moral reformer (Jose Ferrer) in the postwar Pacific.

title: You Were Never Lovelier
description: A tycoon (Adolphe Menjou) sends anonymous gifts to his daughter (Rita Hayworth) to make her fall for a mystery man he will choose later, but a dancer (Fred Astaire) he doesn't like takes the credit.

title: Five Easy Pieces
description: A former concert pianist (Jack Nicholson) who works in an oil field takes his waitress girlfriend (Karen Black) to visit his wealthy, cultured family.

title: Dr. Strangelove Or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
description: President Muffley and his advisers man the Pentagon war room, as planes with bombs head toward Moscow.

title: Oliver!
description: Dickens' Oliver Twist goes from parish boy to Fagin's pickpocketing school to the clutches of murderous Bill Sikes.

title: The Mouse That Roared
description: The field marshal, prime minister and grand duchess (Peter Sellers) of Fenwick declare war on the United States.

title: The Howards of Virginia
description: Politics divide a Williamsburg couple (Cary Grant, Martha Scott) as events lead to the Revolutionary War.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (Humphrey Bogart), his tank crew (Bruce Bennett, Dan Duryea) and stragglers hold off a Nazi battalion at a waterhole.

title: The Magic Carpet
description: An ousted prince harnesses the power of a mystical floor covering to drive a villainous caliph from the throne.

title: Our Wife
description: A composer (Melvyn Douglas) goes on a cruise and meets a woman (Ruth Hussey) he likes more than his wife (Ellen Drew).

title: Hook, Line and Sinker
description: A man (Jerry Lewis) runs up a fortune in bills after his doctor (Peter Lawford) tells him he has only months to live.

title: The Three Stooges in Orbit
description: Three men get mixed up with some Martian spies' invention.

title: The Wackiest Ship in the Army
description: A captain (Jack Lemmon) and his ensign (Ricky Nelson) take a sorry ship and crew on a World War II spy mission.

title: The Caine Mutiny

title: Fail-Safe

title: Jeanne Eagels
description: A 1920s dancer/actress (Kim Novak) leaves her jealous lover (Jeff Chandler) for Broadway, Hollywood and alcoholic decline.

title: The Ambushers
description: A secret agent (Dean Martin) saves a flying-saucer prototype and its pilot (Janice Rule) in the third of four Matt Helm movies.

title: You Belong to Me
description: A doctor's (Barbara Stanwyck) idle millionaire husband (Henry Fonda) becomes unbearably jealous of her patients.

title: Under the Yum Yum Tree
description: A lusty landlord (Jack Lemmon) eyes a coed (Carol Lynley) who is trying to live platonically with her boyfriend (Dean Jones).

title: It Should Happen to You
description: An executive (Peter Lawford) and a filmmaker (Jack Lemmon) woo a model (Judy Holliday) famous for having her name on a billboard.

title: You Can't Take It With You

title: Funny Girl
description: Ziegfeld Follies star Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) falls for gambler Nicky Arnstein (Omar Sharif).
